in_hebrew.name: Sid
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Sid הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'sidan,' meaning 'side.' In the Middle Ages, Sid was used as a nickname for a person who was a follower or attendant, and was also used to refer to someone who was on the 'side' of a battle or dispute. The name Sid has since been used as a given name in its own right, and is popular in various parts of the world, including England and India.
